_meta.purpose: Per-country NBA viewing data for the European How to Watch pages. New file: data/countries.json in jsierrahoopshype/nba-watch-guide.

confidence_rules.moderate: Dated 2026 secondary reporting. Render with a short check-before-you-buy note.
confidence_rules.low: Conflicting or stale. Render as 'not confirmed'.

_meta.league_pass_note: League Pass has no blackouts outside the US and Canada: every game is available live. 2026-27 prices are not published yet in any of these countries; price fields stay null until they are.
_meta.league_pass_price_note: Each country's league_pass block holds its League Pass prices in the local currency: monthly_price and season_price, null until published. A filled price renders on the next build with no code change; set price_verified true and source_url once checked, or the page adds a check-before-you-buy line.
_meta.flag_note: flag names the SVG in assets/flags/ (ISO 3166 code, lower case) shown on the hub's country cards. A country with no flag file is shown without one.
_meta.player_overrides_note: player_overrides lists active players the career map has no nationality for (or a different one), by name as the career map spells it. Each one is listed on that country's page with their current team.
